settings.title: The best winter investment you'll make
How do I use the Snow Melting mats?

settings.text:
Our HotStep Snow Melting Mats are engineered to maintain a safe temperature range of 5-7 degrees Celsius. This prevents snow accumulation without becoming overly hot or hazardous to walk on. This feature ensure your mats stay warm enough to melt snow but remain safe to walk on, offering peace of mind in winter conditions.

Follow these steps to maximize efficiency and safety:

settings.title: Step 1: Prepare Before Snowfall
settings.text: Turn on the mats before snow starts to prevent accumulation of snow on top of the mats. This ensures they effectively prevent snow buildup.

settings.title: Step 2: Avoid Deep Snow Activation
settings.text: If mats are buried under more than one inch of snow, avoid turning them on, as melted snow at the bottom may refreeze. You many need to shovel the snow before turning it on.

settings.title: Step 3: Use with Automation
settings.text: Consider using temperature or snow-sensing thermostats to activate mats automatically when needed, maintaining consistent melting without manual effort.

settings.title: How HotStep Snow Melting Mats Work?

settings.text: HotStep Snow Melting Mats work by heating to just above freezing, melting snow on contact to keep walkways, driveways, and stairs clear and safe. Made from durable, weather-resistant materials, they’re designed for tough winter conditions. The mats can be easily connected to cover large areas, offering efficient, energy-saving snow and ice removal for both residential and commercial use.

settings.title: How do I connect multiple mats to cover a large area?
settings.text: HotStep Snow Melting Mats are designed with easy-to-use male and female connectors, allowing you to daisy chain mats together and create custom pathways. Unlike other mats, our connectors snap together effortlessly, even in cold conditions or with gloves on.

settings.title: How much snow can the mats melt per hour, and how quickly do they work?
settings.text: Our mats can melt 1.5 to 2.5 inches of snow per hour. However, performance depends on factors such as pre-existing snow or ice and the ambient temperature.

settings.title: How energy-efficient are the mats, and will they increase my electricity bill?
settings.text: Thanks to advanced heating film technology, our mats are about 20% more energy-efficient than other snow melting mats. They melt snow faster at the same wattage, meaning you’ll save around 20% on electricity compared to less efficient options.

settings.title: Are the mats waterproof and safe to leave outside all winter?
settings.text: Yes, the mats are waterproof and made to withstand harsh weather. Constructed from heavy-duty rubber and equipped with watertight electrical connections, they’re safe to use outdoors, even in rain and snow, all winter long.

settings.title: Can the mats handle heavy vehicles like trucks or SUVs?
settings.text: Absolutely. HotStep Snow Melting Mats feature a durable, heavy-duty rubber construction with an enclosed heating film, making them strong enough to to handle the weight of cars being driven over them.

settings.title: Are the mats safe to use on stairs and uneven surfaces?
settings.text: Yes, our mats are specifically designed for stairs and other uneven surfaces, reducing the risk of dangerous slips and falls.
